headline: Kumamoto earthquake: restart of operations rushed, impact uncertain due to stalled parts supply – Toyota: Jiji.com
summary: A week after a magnitude-7 intensity earthquake in Kumamoto Prefecture, Toyota is rushing to rebuild production. Aisin Kyushu, a Toyota-affiliated door parts maker, was affected, and the parts shortfall is spilling over into vehicle output.
why: Toyota is one of the world's largest carmakers, and its output depends on a network of parts suppliers such as Aisin, so supply disruptions can affect its volumes and earnings.

impacts.name: Toyota Motor
impacts.why: Earthquake-related parts shortages are disrupting Toyota's vehicle production.
